normalized.summary: Richard Metzler and Yaneer Bar-Yam, Multiscale complexity of correlated Gaussians, Physical Review E 71: 046114 (2005). Download PDF Abstract We apply a recently developed measure of multiscale complexity to the Gaussian model consisting of continuous spins with bilinear interactions for a variety of interaction matrix structures.
